items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Virginia Mayhew with me...

ctx.x: Virginia was interviewed via Zoom on May 23, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Virginia Mayhew with me, saxophonist and composer, and I hear you do karate as well.
I do. I’ve been doing karate a long time. It’s been life changing actually. I’ve been doing it since I first moved to New York so that’s over thirty years.
